title: Utillian 6 Extended Mouthpiece
description:
The Utillian 6 Extended Mouthpiece is an optional but important accessory for your Utillian 6 Wax Pen. This extended mouthpiece is crafted from silicone rubber and provides an increased length that allows the vapor to cool down before it reaches your mouth. The comfortable and cool vapor doesn’t come at the expense of flavor, thanks to the metal rods inside the mouthpiece that preserve the pure taste of your concentrates.

Enhanced Comfort And Cooler Vapor
The Utillian 6 Extended Mouthpiece is designed to boost your vaping experience with enhanced comfort and cooler vapor. The Mouthpiece gives your U6 more space for the vapor to travel through before reaching your lips, resulting in cooler vapor.

Pure Vapor, Uncompromised
Despite its silicone construction, the Utillian 6 Extended Mouthpiece doesn’t compromise on vapor quality. Ingeniously designed with an internal metal rod, the vapor path delivers your concentrates full flavor and potency and remains pure and unaffected.

A Perfect Fit
This extended mouthpiece seamlessly integrates with your Utillian 6 Wax Pen and provides a secure fit and optimal airflow. Its ergonomic design ensures a comfortable grip and allows users to see the Ruby Terp Pearl in action.
